```artifact
Feature: Doctor, Chemist, and Lab Management
  Background:
    As a healthcare system
    I want to manage doctors, chemists, and labs effectively
    To ensure proper management, I must test the functional requirements

  Scenario: Add a new unique Doctor
    Given a requirement to add a new Doctor with specific details
    When the system is used to add a new Doctor with Name, Age, Sex, Qualification, and Experience
    Then the system should verify the uniqueness of the Doctor and create the record if all details are valid
    @Negative Scenario Outline: When the system is used to add a duplicate Doctor
    Examples:
      | Name    | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Expected Outcome        |
      | John Doe | 35  | M   | MD           | 10 years     | Duplicate Doctor Error |

  Scenario: View and Update Doctor Details (Speciality cannot be updated)
    Given a Doctor record exists
    When attempting to update the Doctor's Speciality
    Then the system should prevent the update and display an error message
    Examples:
      | Speciality | Expected Outcome          |
      | Cardiology | Speciality Update Error |

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor record exists and no Patient Consultation Request is pending
    When attempting to delete the Doctor
    Then the system should delete the record
    Examples:
      | Pending Request | Expected Outcome       |
      | No             | Record Deleted        |

  Scenario: Maintain Chemist & Lab Details
    Given a requirement to maintain Chemist and Lab Details
    When adding a new Chemist or Lab
    Then the system should allow only one per Pincode
    When attempting to update the details of an existing Chemist or Lab
    Then the system should prevent the update
    Examples:
      | Chemist/Lab | Expected Outcome                   |
      | Chemist     | Update Error                    |
      | Lab         | Update Error                    |

  Scenario: Delete Chemist & Lab Details
    Given a Chemist or Lab record exists and no Prescription is pending
    When attempting to delete the Chemist or Lab
    Then the system should delete the record
    Examples:
      | Prescription | Expected Outcome          |
      | No          | Record Deleted        |
